visual.general_description: Four-panel light-microscopy figure of kidney tissue labelled a to d: three pink-purple stained views and one dark polarized-light view, each with black arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a: Panel letter a is printed at the upper left. A diagonal band of pink and purple stained tissue crosses the field from the lower left toward the upper right, with pale empty space on either side. The band contains many closely packed tubular profiles with open lumina and scattered small dark nuclei; some areas at the upper left of the field look more crowded with small dark nuclei. One black arrow lies in the middle of the field, pointing up and to the left toward a tubular profile. No scale bar or other printed text is visible. Panel b: Panel letter b is printed at the upper left. Pink-stained tubules with round purple nuclei surround two roughly round areas of pale, glassy, translucent crystalline-looking material that fills tubular spaces. A longer black arrow points up and to the left at the larger area at the center left; a second, shorter black arrow at the right points up and to the left at a second area. Adjacent tubules have open lumina and cytoplasm that varies in staining. No scale bar or other printed text is visible. Panel c: Panel letter c is printed at the upper left of the panel. In the upper right part of the field a glomerulus with a tuft of capillary loops and small nuclei is visible, bordered by tubules with pink cytoplasm. At the lower left a tubule contains a fan-shaped bundle of purple-gray, needle-like or polyhedral crystalline material with straight edges. One black arrow at the lower center points up and to the left at the crystalline material. No scale bar or other printed text is visible. Panel d: Panel letter d is printed at the upper left. The field is a uniform dark magenta-purple background with faint tissue texture. Four small bright white and silvery speckled fragments are scattered across the field: one at the upper right, one at the right of center, one at the lower center, and the one at the left of center that is marked by a black arrow pointing up and to the left. No scale bar or other printed text is visible.

visual.detailed_description: Five light-blue rounded rectangles with thin gray outlines on a white background. Three are stacked in one column and labelled, from top to bottom, Ascorbic Acid, Dihydroascorbic acid and 2,3-diketogulonic acid, joined by straight gray downward arrows. From the lowest stacked box two curved gray arrows branch down and apart, to a box labelled L-threose at the lower left and a box labelled Oxalic acid at the lower right. No numbers, enzyme names, chemical structures or other text are printed.
